description: Refactor the FastAPI skill documentation by reorganizing content into a modular reference structure and optimizing context for better usability. Create a clear main skill document with concise guidance while moving detailed technical information into categorized reference files.
functional_requirements: Create a main SKILL.md document that provides high-level guidance and references to detailed technical documentation
Organize technical content into categorized reference files (dependencies, other-tools, streaming) with clear separation of concerns
Optimize context by trimming redundant information and ensuring each document has a specific, focused purpose
Establish clear cross-references between the main skill document and reference files for easy navigation
Ensure all documentation follows consistent formatting and structure for maintainability
Validate that the refactored documentation provides complete coverage of the original content without information loss
